description:
How do New Covenant Christians relate to the 4th commandment? Is the seventh-day Sabbath still binding upon the New Testament church? Seventh-day Adventist pastor Jose LaPorte and Baptist pastor and apologist Tony Costa (@tonycostatorontoapologetic5307) debate these important issues in light of the biblical witness.
